Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

RDataScienceCompendium 0.2.0

First release as an installable, tested R package and research compendium.

New features

  • boot_ci(): percentile, basic, normal and BCa bootstrap intervals, numerically identical to boot::boot.ci(); jackknife_influence().
  • perm_test(): exact or Monte Carlo two-sample permutation and one-sample/paired sign-flip tests with Phipson-Smyth p-values.
  • cohens_d(), hedges_g(), hedges_correction(): standardised mean differences with exact noncentral-t intervals.
  • run_simulation(), sim_performance(), sim_n_required(), rng_streams(): reproducible simulation studies with per-replicate L’Ecuyer-CMRG streams, captured failures, and Morris et al. (2019) performance measures with Monte Carlo SEs.
  • make_folds(), cross_validate(), nested_cv(): stratified, grouped and nested cross-validation, reporting fold-averaged and pooled estimates.
  • auc(), auc_ci() (DeLong), brier_score(), log_loss(), calibration(), rmse(), mae(), r_squared().
  • simulate_linear(), simulate_logistic(), ar1_cor(): data generators with known ground truth.

Research compendium

  • analysis/: two ADEMP simulation studies (interval coverage under skew; optimism of cross-validation after model selection) with committed results, figures and a paper, regenerated by make analysis.
  • Three vignettes covering resampling inference, simulation studies and model evaluation.

Infrastructure

  • R CMD check on Linux, macOS and Windows (R 4.1 to devel), coverage, lintr and pkgdown workflows.
  • Reproducible Docker image and a real renv.lock.
  • The previous tutorial scripts moved from R/ to modules/.
